task.ques: Find the video on YouTube: 'Oscars 2023: Must-See Moments!'. Tell me who the first comment displayed under that video belongs to, and how many thumbs up and replies it has.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The first displayed comment under “Oscars 2023: Must-See Moments!” by Entertainment Tonight belongs to @HotFuzzGoonayorum. It has 399 thumbs up and 0 replies.

The comment reads: “They really just went and won everything everywhere all at once”. YouTube shows 399 beside its thumbs-up icon and no reply thread; its replies section is empty. Evidence: final.png, captured on October 27, 2026, showing the video title and first comment together.
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WOZk2ni4lCM
